x: Fred Bentley has been invalided out of the Police after his accident in a plane. He has now started business at the Post Office, Blackmore, Liss, Hants.

George Bentley was second in the handicap and the B Team second in the Team Handicap. A fortnight later in the Enfield Open, the local lads took advantage of their knowledge of the course and narrowly won from us by 3 points.
Team Championship.—3rd Cadogan A.C., 45 points. Readman, 5; Rutland, 10; Oliver, 14; Bentley, 16.

At seven miles Proctor was well away in the lead, Charlie and Mac still 5th and 6th, Readman 12th, Oliver 18th, Sapcote 20th, Bidgood 24th, Bentley 26th, Wright 28th, with Clayton taking it easy owing to a strained leg.

… Pat Sapcote, with Bob McMullen, walking his first 20, some 40 yards further back, followed by Messrs. Wright, Bidgood, Bentley and Oliver. It is interesting to note that Jack Rutland, who finished 4th, was at this stage 12th.…
Much could be written of Tommy Green’s magnificent performances and those of Fred Rickards, Fred Bentley and others, but space does not permit.

We have had a number of placed men - Tommy Green on three occasions - but never a winner. Here's a target for next year; to beat our 1938 winning team score of 23 points (Bentley 2, Sutton 4, Bidgood 8 Rickards 9)!
